RECOMMENDATION: DON'T RAISE IT
LIKELIHOOD: 0

Both you and the successful candidate are men, meaning sex was almost certainly not the deciding factor between you. While an all-male panel may reflect broader diversity deficits within the bank's leadership, it does not demonstrate sex-based discrimination against you. 

The bank likely prioritized "broad experience of regulatory affairs" over deep statistical modelling expertise, a common strategic requirement for senior risk roles facing heavy regulatory scrutiny. Raising sex bias without disparate treatment will harm your professional credibility. Instead, send a polite follow-up requesting feedback, focusing on how you can better demonstrate regulatory and leadership competencies for future senior opportunities.
